name: Kadokawa Corporation
summary: Kadokawa Corporation operates as an entertainment company in Japan. It operates through five segments: Publishing and IP Creation, Animation and Live-Action Film, Games, Web Services, and Education. The Publishing and IP Creation segment engages in the publication and sales of books, e-books, magazines, and e-magazines; web advertising sales; and other IP creation-related planning and sale. Its Animation and Live-Action Film segment is involved in the planning, production, and distribution of anime and live-action films; licensing of video distribution rights; and sale of video package software.
